structured.answer: I'm not deciding alone. The page seems to say the cheapest is a פסגות account with the 'אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125' fund (86,045 ₪ left after 10 years, 1,049 ₪ cost), while my big banks cost far more (Leumi 4,506, Hapoalim 6,530). But I don't know פסגות, so I'll ask my son or the bank before doing anything.
